description: This Java class provides custom assertions for testing ThingErrorResponse objects in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within command response assertions.

classes.name: ThingErrorResponseAssert
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractCommandResponseAssert that provides custom assertion methods for the ThingErrorResponse type.

methods.name: ThingErrorResponseAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion object with the actual response.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected type.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected Ditto headers.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Asserts that the response has the expected HTTP status code.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that the response's status code equals the expected status code.

methods.name: withDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Asserts that the response's DittoRuntimeException equals the expected exception.

methods.name: withDittoRuntimeExceptionOfType
methods.description: Asserts that the response's DittoRuntimeException is of the expected type.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Private helper method to assert equality of two values with a custom error message.
